articles.summary: Gold Production Increases 19% Quarter over Quarter, Full-Year Guidance Remains on Track at the Asanko Gold Mine Vancouver, British Columbia-(Newsfile Corp. - November 5, 2026) - Galiano Gold Inc. (TSX: GAU) (NYSE American: GAU) ("Galiano" or the "Company") is pleased to report its third quarter ("Q3") 2026 operating and financial results. Galiano's operating asset is its 90% interest in the Asanko Gold Mine ("AGM") located in the Republic of Ghana, West Africa. "Our team delivered a strong third quarter producing 40,922 gold ounces, improving all-in sustaining costs and achieving positive operating cash flows of $57 million. These results reflect the strength of our operations and position us well to achieve our full-year 2026 production and cost guidance," said Matt Badylak, Galiano's President and Chief Executive Officer.
